first_run: 0 matching application events and 74 boundary-review rows: insert 74 immutable events in the same future transaction as status updates
conflict_target: ON CONFLICT (event_key) WHERE package_id = 'reading-segment-reviewed-boundary-execution' and event_version = 1 and decision_id is not null and book_id is not null and segment_key is not null and event_action in ('status-advanced', 'status-rollback') and event_key is not null DO NOTHING
duplicate_behavior: Predicate-bearing ON CONFLICT may DO NOTHING only when followed by equality verification of every structured identity column, event_type, canonical details payload, run_id, before/after status, target identity, authority_manifest_hash, and package_hash; DO NOTHING alone never proves equality; exact match is verified no-op
conflicting_duplicate: same logical identity or event_key with any immutable difference fails closed as AUDIT_CONFLICT
partial_state: counts must be exactly 0 or 74 for applicable state; any 1..73 event count, event/status disagreement, or status without event fails closed
complete_repeat: 74 matching events plus 74 content-review rows is classified as complete verified no-op for application; rollback still requires later authority
rollback_not_authorized: schema supports rollback event identity but does not authorize rollback execution
